claims.head: Depth against star power
claims.body: On depth, NY Islanders sits 1st of 32, at the deep end of the scale. Ottawa is 26th, at the top-heavy end.

notes.text: M. Barzal has not played this season. V. Eklund is in his usual spot beside B. Schenn and C. Ritchie. K. Palmieri has moved into Eklund’s old spot beside B. Horvat and S. Holmstrom.
K. Palmieri is no longer killing penalties: 0% of the team’s shorthanded time in 4 games, down from 37% last season.
J. Spence has started killing penalties: on the ice for 41% of the team’s shorthanded time in 4 games, up from 4% last season.

OTT.head: Ottawa should have the upper hand
OTT.body: Ottawa has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. NY Islanders can make it interesting if it keeps shots to a minimum.

NYI.head: A tough matchup for NY Islanders
NYI.body: Ottawa has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. NY Islanders’s best way through is keeping shots to a minimum.
